==Usage==
This template is used to create rows for comic book issues in comic tables. Parameter {{Para|tpb}} is used to add collections using {{Tl|Comictable-tpb}}, where applicable.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Comictable-issue|''number''|''title''|''release date''|''type''|tpb=}}
Valid types are "collected", "released", "released-int", and "future". Default is "released".

[[Category:Utility templates]]</noinclude>
